name: scss
description: Sass (scss) build system for themes.  Note that for themes in _custom to actually work, you also need the main vite js build to run to copy the assets (images, fonts, etc.)

scriptsComments.build/watch: The flags --silence-deprecation=color-functions,global-builtin,import,if-function are there because as of 2025-12-18, bootstrap 5.3.6 hasn't fixed everything.  See https://github.com/orgs/twbs/discussions/41370.  In addition, our own code requires ignoring @import deprecation, because we can't run px sass-migrator module --migrate-deps --load-path=../../templates --load-path=../../themes ../../themes/**/**/*.scss on our own codebase until bootstrap is fixed.  benoitg - 2025-06-09 EDIT Jomagene 2025-10-20: The 'mixed-decls' flag was removed as it became obsolete in newer Sass compiler versions (post v1.92.0) and was causing a new build warning.

devDependenciesComments.boosted: Set to ~5.2, as of 2025-06-09 more recent versions are currently incompatible with our boosted theme.
devDependenciesComments.bootswatch: Should normally match the version of boostrap in src/sj/common-externals/package.json
